name: Labrador Retriever
exercise: Needs daily walks, retrieve games, and swimming sessions.
grooming: Weekly brushing and regular ear care.
description: Labrador Retrievers are dependable family dogs known for their kind temperament, trainability, and love of activity both on land and in water.
facts: Originally developed to help fishermen.
Frequently chosen as service and therapy dogs.

name: Golden Retriever
exercise: Thrives on fetch, swimming, and active family outings.
grooming: Brush several times a week to manage shedding.
description: Golden Retrievers combine affection and intelligence with a patient, social nature that makes them a favorite for families and working roles.
facts: Excellent swimmers.
Often used in emotional support and therapy work.

name: German Shepherd
exercise: Needs training games, long walks, and mental work every day.
grooming: Brush weekly and more often during shedding seasons.
description: German Shepherds are deeply loyal, highly trainable dogs valued for their versatility in homes, sports, and professional working environments.
facts: Popular in police and military roles.
Excel in obedience and protection sports.

name: French Bulldog
exercise: Short daily walks and indoor play are usually enough.
grooming: Low grooming, but facial folds need regular cleaning.
description: French Bulldogs are compact companion dogs with expressive ears, comic personalities, and a calm social style that suits city living.
facts: Their bat ears are a defining hallmark.
They are popular apartment dogs.

name: Poodle
exercise: Enjoys brisk walks, games, and advanced trick training.
grooming: Requires frequent brushing and professional grooming.
description: Poodles are athletic and bright dogs with elegant looks, quick learning ability, and a low-shedding coat that needs consistent care.
facts: Standard Poodles were skilled water retrievers.
They are among the most intelligent dog breeds.

name: Bulldog
exercise: Moderate strolls with careful heat management.
grooming: Low coat care but routine wrinkle cleaning is important.
description: Bulldogs are sturdy and affectionate companions with a relaxed pace, a lovable wrinkled face, and a gentle attachment to their people.
facts: Their look is instantly recognizable.
They prefer shorter exercise sessions.

name: Beagle
exercise: Needs scent games, walks, and secure outdoor play.
grooming: Easy weekly brushing and ear checks.
description: Beagles are joyful scent hounds with big personalities, keen noses, and an enthusiastic nature that loves companionship and exploration.
facts: Their nose is one of their biggest strengths.
They often vocalize with a classic bay.

name: Rottweiler
exercise: Needs structured walks, obedience work, and strength-building play.
grooming: Weekly brushing and nail care.
description: Rottweilers are powerful guardians that thrive with confident training, close family bonds, and steady routines that engage mind and body.
facts: Historically drove cattle and pulled carts.
They are calm when well-socialized.

name: Dachshund
exercise: Moderate walks and games that avoid jumping strain.
grooming: Varies by coat type from easy to moderate.
description: Dachshunds are bold little hunters with long bodies, alert expressions, and a surprising amount of confidence packed into a small frame.
facts: Originally bred to hunt badgers.
Their nickname is sausage dog.

name: Siberian Husky
exercise: Needs vigorous daily exercise and cool-weather activity.
grooming: Heavy seasonal shedding requires frequent brushing.
description: Siberian Huskies are social endurance dogs with striking looks, independent thinking, and a strong need for movement and enrichment.
facts: Bred to pull sleds over long distances.
Known for expressive vocal sounds.

name: Boxer
exercise: Needs energetic play, training drills, and active walks.
grooming: Minimal coat care with regular skin checks.
description: Boxers are exuberant, affectionate athletes that stay puppy-like for years and build strong attachments to active households.
facts: They are expressive with their paws.
Many remain playful well into adulthood.

name: Great Dane
exercise: Moderate daily walks and controlled play suit this giant breed.
grooming: Simple weekly brushing.
description: Great Danes are gentle giants with elegant outlines, sweet temperaments, and a surprisingly affectionate need to stay close to their family.
facts: One of the tallest dog breeds.
Despite size, many are calm indoors.

name: Border Collie
exercise: Requires advanced training, running, and constant mental work.
grooming: Brush weekly and monitor feathering.
description: Border Collies are brilliant herding dogs that crave purpose, fast learning challenges, and enough activity to match their endless stamina.
facts: Often considered one of the smartest breeds.
They thrive in agility and herding sports.

name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
exercise: Enjoys moderate walks and cuddly downtime.
grooming: Brush frequently to prevent tangles.
description: Cavalier King Charles Spaniels are soft-hearted lap companions with a sweet face, silky coat, and easygoing social manner.
facts: Named after British royalty.
They balance playfulness with affection.

name: Shih Tzu
exercise: Short walks and indoor play fit this companion breed.
grooming: High grooming needs if coat is kept long.
description: Shih Tzus are cheerful companion dogs bred for company, prized for their flowing coats, affectionate manners, and adaptable temperament.
facts: Their name means lion dog.
They were cherished in imperial courts.

name: Australian Shepherd
exercise: Needs active play, herding style games, and problem-solving work.
grooming: Brush weekly and manage seasonal shedding.
description: Australian Shepherds are quick-footed, bright herders that bond closely and thrive when they have real jobs to do.
facts: Popular in agility and ranch work.
They often have naturally bobbed tails.

name: Yorkshire Terrier
exercise: Short walks and playful indoor activity work well.
grooming: Frequent brushing and trimming are essential.
description: Yorkshire Terriers are tiny but confident dogs with glamorous coats, quick wit, and a fearless terrier heart.
facts: Once used to catch rodents in mills.
Their coat resembles human hair.

name: Doberman Pinscher
exercise: Needs daily training, brisk movement, and confidence-building work.
grooming: Low maintenance coat care.
description: Doberman Pinschers are sleek, athletic guardians with sharp minds, deep loyalty, and a strong desire to stay engaged with their people.
facts: Created by a tax collector seeking protection.
They are known for elegance and speed.

name: Pembroke Welsh Corgi
exercise: Daily walks and puzzle games keep them satisfied.
grooming: Weekly brushing and regular shedding management.
description: Pembroke Welsh Corgis are spirited low-set herders with expressive faces, eager intelligence, and a remarkably cheerful attitude.
facts: Associated with British royal popularity.
They were bred to move cattle by nipping heels.

name: Chihuahua
exercise: Short walks and cozy play sessions are enough.
grooming: Low to moderate depending on coat length.
description: Chihuahuas are tiny companions with huge personalities, strong loyalty, and an alert spirit that often makes them seem bigger than they are.
facts: One of the smallest dog breeds in the world.
They often bond tightly with one person.

name: Bernese Mountain Dog
exercise: Needs daily walks and cool-weather outdoor time.
grooming: Frequent brushing helps manage the heavy coat.
description: Bernese Mountain Dogs are gentle, devoted working dogs admired for their tri-color coats and calm family-centered nature.
facts: Traditionally pulled carts on Swiss farms.
They handle cold weather especially well.

name: Pomeranian
exercise: Short walks and playful enrichment suit them well.
grooming: Needs frequent brushing to maintain a full coat.
description: Pomeranians are tiny extroverts with fluffy coats, alert minds, and a lively presence that easily commands attention.
facts: Descended from larger spitz sled dogs.
Their foxlike face is a signature trait.

name: Boston Terrier
exercise: Moderate daily walks and fun games keep them fit.
grooming: Easy coat care with face and eye attention.
description: Boston Terriers are cheerful city-friendly companions with tuxedo markings, an eager nature, and a love of being in the middle of family life.
facts: Nicknamed the American Gentleman.
Their compact build suits apartment living.

name: Saint Bernard
exercise: Moderate walks and controlled low-impact activity.
grooming: Routine brushing with extra care during shedding.
description: Saint Bernards are giant, warmhearted companions known for their calm demeanor, massive size, and historic alpine rescue legacy.
facts: Associated with rescue work in the Alps.
Their gentle expression matches their temperament.

name: Cocker Spaniel
exercise: Enjoys daily walks, sniffing games, and fetch.
grooming: Frequent brushing and regular trimming are needed.
description: Cocker Spaniels are soft-eyed, affectionate sporting dogs with merry personalities and elegant feathered coats.
facts: Their long ears need routine cleaning.
They are known for a cheerful wagging tail.

name: Akita
exercise: Needs structured walks and confident social training.
grooming: Brush often, especially during coat blow seasons.
description: Akitas are strong, reserved guardians with deep loyalty, plush coats, and a composed presence around their household.
facts: A symbol of loyalty in Japan.
They are naturally clean and catlike in some habits.

name: Basset Hound
exercise: Moderate walking and scent games suit them well.
grooming: Simple brushing with routine ear and skin care.
description: Basset Hounds are laid-back scent hounds with soulful eyes, long ears, and a determined nose that always wants to investigate.
facts: Their low body helps them follow scent trails closely.
They are famous for their mournful expression.

name: Australian Cattle Dog
exercise: Needs intense daily activity and mental challenges.
grooming: Low grooming with seasonal brushing.
description: Australian Cattle Dogs are resilient and hardworking herders that excel when given structure, movement, and a job to focus on.
facts: Sometimes called Blue Heelers.
Bred to work long distances in harsh conditions.

name: Alaskan Malamute
exercise: Requires powerful exercise and cool weather activities.
grooming: Heavy coat needs frequent brushing.
description: Alaskan Malamutes are powerful northern dogs with dense coats, affectionate pack instincts, and a love for outdoor adventure.
facts: Bred to haul heavy freight in Arctic regions.
They are stronger than the lighter Siberian Husky.

name: Cane Corso
exercise: Needs steady training, walks, and controlled strength work.
grooming: Low grooming coat with regular skin care.
description: Cane Corsos are imposing yet deeply loyal guardians that need early training, leadership, and close family connection.
facts: Descended from Roman working dogs.
They are confident and serious by nature.

name: Chow Chow
exercise: Moderate walks and calm routines work best.
grooming: Heavy grooming requirements for the rough coat.
description: Chow Chows are lionlike, self-possessed companions with a famously reserved demeanor and a distinctive plush silhouette.
facts: Known for a blue-black tongue.
They often behave with catlike independence.

name: Collie
exercise: Daily walks and training games are ideal.
grooming: Rough-coated Collies need regular deep brushing.
description: Collies are graceful, family-oriented herders that blend trainability, sensitivity, and a soft affectionate expression.
facts: Made famous by Lassie.
They are naturally responsive to training.

name: Dalmatian
exercise: Needs vigorous running and structured play daily.
grooming: Low grooming coat but year-round shedding.
description: Dalmatians are athletic spotted dogs with stamina, style, and a lively nature that loves motion and companionship.
facts: Historically worked alongside horse-drawn coaches.
Their spots develop after birth.

name: English Springer Spaniel
exercise: Needs field-style play, walks, and regular training.
grooming: Brush often and tidy feathering.
description: English Springer Spaniels are upbeat sporting dogs with strong work ethic, soft expressions, and a love of being busy with people.
facts: Bred to flush game birds.
They are enthusiastic and highly trainable.

name: German Shorthaired Pointer
exercise: Needs intense outdoor exercise, running, and scent work.
grooming: Low grooming with occasional brushing.
description: German Shorthaired Pointers are athletic all-purpose sporting dogs that crave action, learning, and outdoor adventure.
facts: Strong swimmers and runners.
They are popular with active hunting homes.

name: Greyhound
exercise: Enjoys sprinting opportunities plus relaxed lounging.
grooming: Very low coat maintenance.
description: Greyhounds are elegant sighthounds that combine explosive speed with a surprisingly calm and gentle personality at home.
facts: Among the fastest dog breeds.
Many retired racers adapt well to homes.

name: Havanese
exercise: Moderate walks and lots of social play.
grooming: Needs brushing several times per week.
description: Havanese are sociable small dogs with springy movement, silky coats, and a deeply people-focused temperament.
facts: The national dog of Cuba.
They are known for a lively gait.

name: Irish Setter
exercise: Needs ample running room and active daily outings.
grooming: Brush often to keep feathering smooth.
description: Irish Setters are graceful red sporting dogs that pair elegance with exuberant energy and an affectionate spirit.
facts: Famous for their deep red coat.
They mature slowly and stay playful for years.

name: Jack Russell Terrier
exercise: Needs intense play, training, and active enrichment.
grooming: Low to moderate grooming depending on coat texture.
description: Jack Russell Terriers are fearless little dynamos with quick minds, huge confidence, and an endless appetite for action.
facts: Bred for fox hunting.
They are excellent escape artists if bored.

name: Mastiff
exercise: Needs controlled daily walks and low-impact movement.
grooming: Simple coat care with regular drool cleanup.
description: Mastiffs are imposing yet gentle giants that prefer calm companionship, steady leadership, and comfortable home routines.
facts: One of the heaviest dog breeds.
Known as quiet protectors of home and family.

name: Miniature Schnauzer
exercise: Enjoys daily walks and problem-solving games.
grooming: Needs routine clipping or hand-stripping.
description: Miniature Schnauzers are spirited small terriers with a signature beard, watchdog instincts, and a sociable family personality.
facts: Their beard and eyebrows are iconic.
They are excellent little watchdogs.

name: Newfoundland
exercise: Moderate exercise with plenty of room and cool weather.
grooming: Heavy brushing is needed to control shedding.
description: Newfoundlands are famously gentle giants with water-loving instincts, impressive strength, and a calm, nurturing temperament.
facts: Known for lifesaving water rescue ability.
Their webbed feet support strong swimming.

name: Papillon
exercise: Moderate walks plus games and agility-style practice.
grooming: Brush a few times a week to maintain feathering.
description: Papillons are elegant toy dogs with butterfly ears, quick intelligence, and a lively, athletic spirit.
facts: Papillon means butterfly in French.
They often shine in canine sports.

name: Pug
exercise: Short walks with close monitoring in heat.
grooming: Low grooming with extra facial wrinkle care.
description: Pugs are affectionate clownish companions with wrinkled faces, compact bodies, and a strong devotion to being near people.
facts: Their curled tail is a classic feature.
They are experts at earning attention.

name: Samoyed
exercise: Needs active exercise, cool weather fun, and companionship.
grooming: Extensive brushing is required year-round.
description: Samoyeds are smiling northern dogs with plush white coats, sociable personalities, and a need for active, involved homes.
facts: Famous for the Samoyed smile.
Their coat provides strong insulation in cold climates.

name: Scottish Terrier
exercise: Moderate walks and engaging terrier games.
grooming: Regular hand-stripping or clipping is needed.
description: Scottish Terriers are self-assured little dogs with dignified posture, strong character, and classic terrier determination.
facts: Recognizable by their beard and sturdy silhouette.
They have a famously independent nature.

name: Shetland Sheepdog
exercise: Needs training sessions, walks, and active play.
grooming: Frequent brushing keeps the coat free of mats.
description: Shetland Sheepdogs are responsive, elegant herders with abundant coats and a strong desire to work with their people.
facts: Often called Shelties.
They excel in obedience and agility.

name: Weimaraner
exercise: Needs hard daily exercise and advanced training.
grooming: Minimal coat care with occasional brushing.
description: Weimaraners are sleek sporting dogs with striking gray coats, strong hunting drive, and a need for very active households.
facts: Called the Gray Ghost.
They are known for staying close to their owners.

name: West Highland White Terrier
exercise: Moderate walks and spirited games keep them content.
grooming: Regular brushing and trimming are needed.
description: West Highland White Terriers are cheerful compact terriers with bright expressions, sturdy confidence, and a crisp white coat.
facts: Often called Westies.
Their white coat helped hunters spot them easily.

name: Whippet
exercise: Enjoys sprinting bursts followed by relaxed rest.
grooming: Very low coat maintenance.
description: Whippets are graceful medium sighthounds that pair quick speed outdoors with a soft, quiet personality indoors.
facts: Sometimes called the poor mans racehorse.
They love comfortable beds and blankets.
